_meta.name: php2shell containment rules (CVE-2026-109618 / CVE-2026-109619)
notes: Containment only. Patch to PHP 8.2.35 / 8.3.36 / 8.4.27 / 8.5.12+ or a vendor backport.
Rule 1 (multipart outside /api/v1/upload) is the highest-value rule: PHP only runs its RFC1867 multipart parser for multipart bodies.
Rule 2's cookie test is a cheap pre-filter, not authentication. Real session validation stays at the origin (nginx auth_request in nginx-multipart-guard.conf).

http.request.body.size (rule 5) depends on plan body-inspection support. If your zone rejects the expression, deploy the ruleset without that rule; nginx client_max_body_size 1m enforces the same limit at the origin.
Rate limiting rules: characteristics must include cf.colo.id; available period and mitigation_timeout values depend on plan (Free: 10s period/timeout).
Change /api/v1/upload and PHPSESSID to match your application before deploying.
deploy: WARNING: PUT on a phase entrypoint REPLACES every existing rule in that phase. Export current rules first:

jq '{rules: .rulesets[0].rules}' cloudflare-waf-rules.json | curl -s -X PUT https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/$CF_ZONE_ID/rulesets/phases/http_request_firewall_custom/entrypoint -H "Authorization: Bearer $CF_API_TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data @-

jq '{rules: .rulesets[1].rules}' cloudflare-waf-rules.json | curl -s -X PUT https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/$CF_ZONE_ID/rulesets/phases/http_ratelimit/entrypoint -H "Authorization: Bearer $CF_API_TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data @-
Dashboard alternative: Security > WAF > Custom rules > Create rule > Edit expression, paste each expression below.

rules.description: php2shell: block multipart/form-data on every route except /api/v1/upload
php2shell: block multipart uploads that carry no session cookie
php2shell: block oversized query strings (array-key / nesting bombs build HashTables before user code runs)
php2shell: block request bodies over 1 MiB outside the upload endpoint
php2shell: throttle the upload endpoint per client IP
php2shell: throttle POST bursts on public routes (OOM probing is high-volume)
